svg.title: Markov spectral mixing
svg.desc: What this figure shows: For an ergodic finite Markov chain, the subdominant eigenvalue magnitude controls asymptotic mixing rate. The plotted object is generated from mixing envelope approximately |lambda_2|^n. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Standard Markov-chain fact. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
